verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a developer-first GraphQL and REST API that covers record CRUD for both built-in and custom objects, plus a Metadata API for creating, modifying and deleting objects, fields and relations, which covers the data and schema layers of the UI. Nothing documents API control of views, dashboards, workflows, AI agents or settings, and the docs never claim full UI parity. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, API coverage for views, dashboards, workflow building and workspace settings, and independent corroboration beyond one community note that the REST API 'worked ok'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: A developer-first API that adapts to your custom data model.
Custom objects get the same first-class treatment as built-in ones — including API endpoints, views, permissions, and workflow triggers.
Schema management: create/modify/delete objects, fields, and relations. This is how you programmatically change your data model.
Both REST and GraphQL support batching up to 60 records per request — create, update, or delete.
